app.name: Simulator
app.title: Circuit Simulator
app.description:
When you build an arbitrary circuit, Electra.Academy shows you how it works, even if you have just invented a new design. This is made possible by a custom-built circuit simulation engine under the hood.

I hope you'll give it a try!

dialog.publish_explain: Create a public link anyone can open (no login required):
dialog.promote_explain: Make your version the shared version? Everyone who sees this circuit under the same "Provided by" group will then get your changes.
dialog.promote_description_label: Note for the reviewers (optional) — what changed and why?
dialog.revert_explain: Discard your personal changes and show the official version again? This cannot be undone.
dialog.delete_explain: Delete this circuit? There is no shared version to fall back to — this cannot be undone.
dialog.open_conflict_explain: You have a personal draft of this circuit. Open your own copy, or the shared original?

review.title: Review
review.intro: Documents waiting for your approval. You vote with the reviewer points the workspace admin granted you; a document is committed once the approving points reach the workspace's threshold. A single reject closes the request.
review.my_points_hint: Your vote adds this many points
review.not_open: This review is no longer open
review.load_failed: Could not load the review document
review.no_change_comment: No change comment — the author did not describe what changed.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.intro: Browse the workspaces you belong to and drill into their sub-workspaces. Any member may create a sub-workspace (you become its admin); admins can add members. A workspace groups all your documents — circuits, sheets, shapes — with one shared membership.
workspaces.create_needs_parent: Open a workspace first, then create a sub-workspace inside it.
workspaces.required_score_hint: Approval points a document must collect before it commits in this workspace. 0 = no review.

draft.title: My Drafts
draft.intro: Your private circuits and your personal versions of public ones. When you edit and save a public circuit, your changes land here — nobody else sees them. Happy with your version? Promote it to propose making it the shared version for everyone in the group.
draft.review_points_explain: {{have}} of {{need}} approval points collected. Once the threshold is reached the document is committed as the public version.
draft.kind_personal_explain: This document exists only in your personal workspace — nobody else can see it.
draft.kind_personal_copy_explain: You have a personal version of a public document. Promote your changes to submit them for review — once approved they become the public version.

files.title: Circuit Library
files.intro: The shared circuits available to you. Open one to use it; editing and saving creates your own draft (see Drafts) without touching the original.
